{{Top|leg}}
The '''s'ae tree''' was native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gacerian]]. They could grow to widths of twelve [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and the average height was one hundred meters tall. A large concentration of s'ae trees made up the [[Singing Forest]].
